queues.Q1: existing 0.6B/8B checkpoints: crossed panels, ordinary tasks, four-TARGET alignment and entropy diagnostics; no training
queues.Q2: frozen SFT checkpoint: exact/MC gradient noise, isolated Adam steps and dev Taylor response in FP32/BF16; then sampled/exact x entropy after numerical gate
queues.Q3: ce, ce_entropy, ce_cf, ce_cf_entropy; identical task panels, seed, exposure order, operation-token CE and prefix scorer
queues.Q4: plain/state/token-control inference on chosen prefixes; state/SIGReg factorial only after a positive paired dev signal

secondary: crossed per-cell A/B accuracy and four-cell joint accuracy
raw H1/H8 and correct-set mass over all candidates
greedy constrained and unconstrained program execution
state prediction and causal projection ablation

policy.secondary: full-vocabulary program score with global leaf softmax; never pooled with local policy
policy.reward: binary population-standard-deviation advantages, G=32, KL=0; exact expectation before Adam/clipping

data.crossed_train_gate: requested panel count AND >=8 distinct programs; otherwise train four-TARGET assignment loss
data.exclusion: all correct-trajectory states and task identities disjoint from inherited data and across new panels/splits
data.length: new atomic-start continuations train only depth<=3; historical SFT has already seen depth4

gates.reward: exact kernel enumeration; Monte Carlo mean within 4 estimated standard errors; finite isolated FP32/BF16 updates and small-step dev Taylor checks
gates.state: paired dev gain of true-current-state over BOTH plain and token-matched control, positive lower 95% panel bootstrap bound
gates.confirmation: explicit dev selection artifact; exactly baseline plus one selected method, masks1/2 and paired seeds0/1/2
gates.external: explicit dev selection artifact; baseline plus selected method on a named small nonlinear DSL, not RobustFill/DeepCoder

statistics.unit: panel with shared START(s), paired arms; average continuation seeds first
statistics.masks: report separately and equal mean; tasks do not replace independent masks
statistics.initialization: shared inherited atomic checkpoint; continuation seeds are not independent full training replications

final: new immutable v3 lock binds plan/code/data/selected method and completed dev training cells; final only evaluates saved final adapters

sigreg.definition: random unit projections and Gaussian-weighted empirical-characteristic-function distance to N(0,1)
sigreg.duplicates: one mean representation per exact (field, dimension, state) within batch
sigreg.interpretation: regularization of compact state projection; no imported LeJEPA guarantees
